map_commands.controls_help:
SELECT — click an army or its commander portrait.
MARCH — click a reachable destination, or drag the army and release. Gold marks ordinary range; orange requires forced march (Shift). Red offers attack or siege, with battle confirmation.
JOURNEYS — M plans a route. A distant destination waits for Issue orders before the army sets out.
SCOUT — cavalry and spies see farther. Build a Watchtower in your territory, then fortify it for greater sight and defense. Scouting coverage shows the observed provinces.
INSPECT — Alt-click a province, or deselect with Esc first. Right-click a unit row for its card.
CAMERA — drag empty land, middle-drag or Space-drag; WASD/arrows pan, wheel/pinch or +/- zoom. F finds the selected force; V changes map detail; Home returns to the capital.
FLEETS — select a fleet and right-click a sea to sail, or your port to dock.
OPTIONS — play or skip the turn sequence; guided objectives; reduced motion.
map_commands.welcome_controls: Click a commander or army, then click a destination to march. Drag the army to preview its road. Space-drag pans; Alt-click inspects. Options ▾ lists all controls.
map_commands.idle_controls: Click an army or commander to select it, then click a gold destination to march. Orange requires forced march; red offers attack or siege.
map_commands.map_intro: Command from the land your scouts have charted. Roads, passes and bridges determine the march; terrain determines the defense.
map_commands.uncharted: Uncharted territory. Send scouts or negotiate access to another court’s maps.
map_commands.map_access_help: Includes their atlas and future geographic reports. Live troop intelligence stays separate. War ends future updates.
